sections.text_helper: Section 16.3.3 "EXTI mux selection" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 450.
sections.section_content:
The EXTI mux allows the selection of GPIOs as interrupts and wake-up. GPIOs are
connected via 16 EXTI mux lines to the first 16 EXTI events as configurable event. The
selection of a GPIO port as EXTI mux output is controlled in EXTI_EXTICRx (x = 1 to 4).
[Figure 61. EXTI mux GPIO selection]
The EXTI mux outputs are available as output signals from the EXTI to trigger other
peripherals, whatever the masking in EXTI_IMR and EXTI_EMR registers.
